description:
Reid Firetrail 1 | Gravel bike

Versatile, capable and built for adventure – the ideal entry-level gravel bike from Reid Bikes for exploring off-road trails, tackling gravel rides, trying cyclocross or adding some adventure to your daily commute.

The Reid Bikes Firetrail 1 is designed to deliver impressive versatility and performance at an accessible price. Combining a lightweight aluminium frame with practical features and a wide range of gearing, it's a great choice for riders looking to venture beyond the tarmac, take on mixed terrain or enjoy a more capable and adventurous commute.

Its aluminium frame is engineered to balance low weight and stiffness, providing responsive handling and reliable control on both road and off-road routes. A lightweight bladed aluminium fork with a thru-axle design adds stability, while clearance for tyres up to 45c gives you the flexibility to choose wider tyres for additional comfort and grip on rougher surfaces. The bike comes fitted with Kenda 40C tyres, offering a versatile setup for gravel tracks, cycle paths and everyday road riding.

A 2x8 drivetrain with LTWOO integrated shifters provides a broad range of gearing for tackling climbs, covering flat stretches and navigating varied terrain. The integrated shifters allow convenient gear changes while keeping your hands close to the brakes, whether riding on the tops or drops of the handlebars. Tektro mechanical disc brakes deliver dependable stopping power and control in a range of weather conditions, helping you ride with confidence on changing surfaces.

Built for more than just weekend adventures, the Reid Bikes Firetrail 1 features mounts for a rear rack, mudguards and additional equipment, making it easy to customise for commuting, bikepacking or longer rides. An all-day comfortable saddle and quality Reid bar tape help keep you comfortable on extended journeys, whether you're heading across town or exploring further afield.

With its adaptable setup, practical mounting options and excellent value, the Reid Bikes Firetrail 1 is a versatile introduction to gravel cycling. From everyday commutes to off-road exploration and multi-day adventures, it's ready to help you discover more on two wheels.

The Reid Firetrail 1 is ideal for:

Gravel riding and off-road exploration, with a lightweight aluminium frame and versatile tyres for mixed terrain

Everyday commuting, with responsive handling and practical mounts for accessories to suit your daily journey

Cyclocross and varied terrain, with a capable frame and clearance for tyres up to 45c

Bikepacking and longer adventures, with rack and equipment mounts for carrying luggage and essential gear

Riders tackling hills and mixed routes, with a 2x8 drivetrain offering a versatile range of gears

Confident gear changes, with LTWOO integrated shifters that combine convenient shifting with easy access to the brakes

Reliable all-weather braking, with Tektro mechanical disc brakes for controlled stopping on changing surfaces

Comfort on longer rides, with Kenda 40C tyres, an all-day saddle and quality Reid bar tape

Riders looking for a versatile first gravel bike, combining practical features, capable performance and excellent value for road and off-road adventures
